DURABLE POWER OF ATTORNEY (FINANCIAL)

STATE OF OREGON
COUNTY OF DESCHUTES

NOTICE TO THE PRINCIPAL: As the Principal, you are giving another person (your Agent) broad powers to handle your property and money. Read this document carefully. You may revoke it at any time while you have capacity.

1. DESIGNATION OF AGENT

I, Rosalind Whitcombe-Achebe, of 1147 Tumalo Ridge Road, Bend, Oregon 97703 (the "Principal"), appoint my daughter, Ndidi Whitcombe-Achebe, of 3320 Skyliner Court, Bend, Oregon 97702, as my agent and attorney-in-fact (the "Agent") to act for me in any lawful way with respect to the powers granted in this instrument.

2. SUCCESSOR AGENT

If Ndidi Whitcombe-Achebe resigns, dies, becomes incapacitated, is not qualified to serve, or declines to act, I appoint my brother, Callum Whitcombe, of 88 Pinehurst Lane, Portland, Oregon 97210, as successor Agent, with the same authority.

3. EFFECTIVE DATE

This power of attorney is effective immediately upon my execution of it and is not conditioned on my incapacity.

4. DURABILITY

This power of attorney is durable. It is not affected by, and does not terminate on, my subsequent disability, incapacity, or the lapse of time, and it survives my incapacity. It terminates only on my death, on my revocation of it in writing, or on a court order terminating it.

5. GRANT OF GENERAL AUTHORITY

I grant my Agent general authority with respect to the following subjects, as those subjects are defined in the Oregon Uniform Power of Attorney Act:

(a) real property, including the power to buy, sell, lease, mortgage, and manage real estate;
(b) tangible personal property;
(c) stocks, bonds, and other securities;
(d) banking and other financial institution transactions, including the power to open, close, and draw on accounts;
(e) business operating transactions, including the operation of Whitcombe Orchards LLC;
(f) insurance and annuities;
(g) estates, trusts, and other beneficial interests;
(h) claims and litigation;
(i) personal and family maintenance;
(j) benefits from governmental programs, including Social Security and Medicare; and
(k) taxes, including the power to prepare, sign, and file federal, state, and local tax returns, to receive confidential tax information, and to represent me before the Internal Revenue Service, and I authorize my Agent to execute IRS Form 2848 on my behalf.

6. SPECIFIC GRANT OF AUTHORITY — "HOT POWERS"

In addition to the general authority above, I specifically authorize my Agent to take the following actions, each of which requires an express grant:

(a) make gifts of my property, outright or in trust, provided that gifts to any one recipient in any calendar year may not exceed the federal gift tax annual exclusion amount, and that my Agent may not make a gift to the Agent or to a person the Agent is legally obligated to support except as permitted by this paragraph;
(b) create, amend, revoke, or terminate an inter vivos trust;
(c) create or change rights of survivorship;
(d) create or change a beneficiary designation;
(e) delegate authority granted under this power of attorney;
(f) waive my right to be a beneficiary of a joint and survivor annuity, including a survivor benefit under a retirement plan; and
(g) disclaim property, including a power of appointment.

7. AGENT'S DUTIES

My Agent accepts appointment by acting under this power of attorney. The Agent's duties are fiduciary duties. The Agent shall act in good faith, in my best interest, within the scope of the authority granted, and with the care, competence, and diligence ordinarily exercised by agents in similar circumstances. The Agent shall act loyally for my benefit, shall not create a conflict of interest that impairs the Agent's ability to act impartially, shall keep a record of all receipts, disbursements, and transactions made on my behalf, and shall not commingle my property with the Agent's own property. On request by me, by a court, or by a person authorized by statute, the Agent shall provide an accounting within thirty (30) days.

8. COMPENSATION AND REIMBURSEMENT

My Agent is entitled to reimbursement of reasonable expenses actually incurred on my behalf and to reasonable compensation for services rendered, to be determined in accordance with the Oregon Uniform Power of Attorney Act.

9. RELIANCE BY THIRD PARTIES

Any person may rely on the authority of my Agent, and on a copy of this instrument certified by my Agent to be a true copy, until that person has actual knowledge that this power of attorney has been terminated or the Agent's authority has been revoked or suspended. A person who in good faith accepts an acknowledged power of attorney without actual knowledge that it is void, invalid, or terminated is not liable to any person for so accepting. A person who refuses to accept this power of attorney in violation of the Oregon Uniform Power of Attorney Act is subject to a court order mandating acceptance and to liability for reasonable attorney fees and costs incurred in the proceeding. I hold harmless any third party who acts in good faith reliance on this instrument.

10. NOMINATION OF CONSERVATOR

If a protective proceeding for my estate is commenced, I nominate my Agent to serve as my conservator.

11. GOVERNING LAW

This power of attorney is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon and is intended to be valid in any jurisdiction in which it is presented.

12. EXECUTION

I sign this instrument on July 9, 2026.

/s/ Rosalind Whitcombe-Achebe
Rosalind Whitcombe-Achebe, Principal

ACKNOWLEDGMENT

STATE OF OREGON, COUNTY OF DESCHUTES

This instrument was acknowledged before me on July 9, 2026, by Rosalind Whitcombe-Achebe.

/s/ Bartholomew Nkemdirim
Bartholomew Nkemdirim, Notary Public for Oregon
My commission expires: April 2, 2030

RECORDING: If this power of attorney is used for a transaction affecting real property, a copy shall be recorded in the office of the county recorder or county clerk of the county in which the real property is located.

AGENT'S CERTIFICATION AND ACCEPTANCE

I, Ndidi Whitcombe-Achebe, certify that I have read this power of attorney, that I accept appointment as Agent, and that I understand and accept the fiduciary duties described in Section 7.

/s/ Ndidi Whitcombe-Achebe
Ndidi Whitcombe-Achebe, Agent
